text.tspan: Does a 70B model fit on one 80 GB H100?
Does NOT fit: split over 2+ GPUs
Fits on 1 GPU · ~10 GB left for KV cache
Fits · ~45 GB for KV cache = many users
Weights = parameters × bytes per weight (70B × 2 bytes = 140 GB). Real serving also needs room for the KV cache and working memory.
